name: Akimoto Sota
source:
A former delinquent turned hot-blooded detective.

"I want to use my strength to protect people," he decided to become a police officer.

He's well-built, polite, and refreshing.

His natural charm helps him get closer to anyone.

He learned to play the alto saxophone from his grandfather,

and he still occasionally plays it.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/sota]Official site[/url]]
